_comment: BUILD-SPEC ONLY. Describes the intentional fault for Part 5 on a COPY of Part 3. edison-org-for-test only.

fault_options.name: wrong-endpoint-plus-validator
fault_options.description: Point HTTP node at a bad path; the Part 3 validate_response node raises on non-2xx so the run FAILS deterministically.
fault_options.why_needed: A bare non-2xx (e.g. 404) may let the HTTP node 'finish'; the validator raise is what makes the run fail.

fault_options.name: deterministic-raise-in-code
fault_options.description: Keep the correct endpoint; add a temporary raise at the top of validate_response to guarantee a failed run with no external dependency.

fix: Restore the correct endpoint (option 1) OR remove the injected raise (option 2), then PUBLISH A NEW VERSION and re-trigger to verify success.
safety: Do not point the fault at a real mutating endpoint/token. Mask tokens in screenshots. Keep the Part 3 test-part + severity=low filter.
